PHYSICS — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic induction? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic induction.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic induction.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic induction.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.

13. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

18. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

19. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
22. In three clear sentences, explain Floating and Sinking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Quantity of Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Thin lenses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Photoelectric effect and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic induction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Mains electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
